capabilities: scan the vault or current note for sensitive data patterns
verify candidate matches with checksums (Luhn, mod-97, modulo 11)
redact findings in reports and exported reports
silence findings per note block or via frontmatter
save the last scan report as a note in the vault
disambiguation: Not an encryption or access-control tool; it only detects and reports sensitive data, it does not remove or protect it.
extras: Manifest carries the disclaimer that the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; MIT licensed; rule packs emphasize Polish identifiers (PESEL, NIP, REGON) alongside international patterns.
problem: Notes accumulate sensitive data pasted or typed in and forgotten, which then gets synced, shared, or published along with the vault.

relations.evidence: What makes it different from grep

summary: Vault scanner that finds sensitive data — national IDs, bank accounts, cards, API keys — and verifies matches with checksums, fully offline.
